_doc: Machine-checkable contract for the saga / mission-control / deploy ship-ceremony seam:
each plugin declares which sensitive `gh` subcommands its checked-in scripts may invoke
directly. scripts/check_ownership_lanes.py statically scans every declared plugin's
scripts and fails CI when a script reaches across into another plugin's owned mutation
surface (e.g. a deploy-lane script calling `gh issue`, which is mission-control's domain).
This gate covers the WRITE-mutation subset of CLAUDE.md Development Workflow step 6; it does
NOT build the richer positive-ack handoff protocol (out of scope, tracked separately).
Extending it: add the plugin under `lanes` with its allowed_gh_subcommands, or add a path
prefix under `reserved_api_paths` to reserve a `gh api <path>` surface to one owner. Only
subcommands listed in `sensitive_subcommands` are enforced; benign reads (gh repo view,
gh auth status, gh search) are never policed.

rationale: Owns the PR ship-ceremony (create / ready / view / merge / close) and read-only GitHub
queries (`gh api` GET for sub-issue graphql, deploy-strategy probing, board-progress
comment preflights). Board-field WRITES are delegated to mission-control's sdlc_manager.py
(the board_writer pattern, #279/#344) — saga never mutates `projects/` directly, which
reserved_api_paths enforces. Not granted `issue` (issue creation/edit is mission-control's).
The SDLC mutation hub: owns issue lifecycle, project/board field writes (`gh api
projects/...` and ProjectV2 graphql mutations), labels, milestones, and repo metadata.
This is the one plugin authorized to reach the board/status-write surface directly.
Reads deployment + compare state via `gh api` (repos/*/deployments, repos/*/compare).
Mints tags via git, not gh. Must NOT touch issues, PRs, or board projects — those are
mission-control's (issues/boards) and saga's (PR ceremony) to own.
